credential_patterns: explicit S3-compatible key/secret configuration is supported by s3-explore
external_effects: creates or appends DuckDB session state files
install-duckdb may offer DuckDB CLI upgrade commands
reads remote object storage and HTTPS resources
read-memories reads local Claude Code session logs

reviewed_subcapabilities.rationale: Useful database attachment workflow, but it writes shared state and can create a database after user confirmation.
Conversion writes user-selected outputs and can access remote sources or install/load extensions.
Documentation lookup is narrow in purpose but installs extensions, downloads indexes, and writes a local cache.
Installer/updater authority is materially broader than a reference skill and includes community-extension and CLI-upgrade paths.
Ad-hoc mode contains useful path/external-access restrictions, but session mode restores shared state that may include secrets and attached databases.
Broad file readers and remote credential-chain support exceed a default reference-only trust boundary.
Reads historical Claude Code session logs and therefore crosses a private-context boundary unsuitable for generic automatic admission.
Remote object-store exploration requires network and may use credentials or explicit access secrets.
Can query remote public datasets, install community extensions, and export local spatial files.

narrower_admission_candidates.condition: Consider only the local ad-hoc query path with external access disabled, persistent secrets disabled, and explicit allowed paths.
Consider a documentation-only path after deciding whether extension installation, network fetch, and cache writes are acceptable.

rationale: Official provenance and useful public capabilities are established, but the package-level Bash, installation/update, credential, network, filesystem, and session-history surfaces are too broad for automatic plugin or skill admission as a unit.
